rules.description: String interpolation ($) is not supported by the default SHVDN3 compiler if it's using an older C# version (pre-6.0).
rules.solution: Replace string interpolation with string.Format() or ensure the script is compiled with C# 6.0+ support. For SHVDN3, use 'string.Format("Value: {0}", value)' instead of '$"Value: {value}"'.
Ensure your project targets .NET Framework 4.8 and all dependencies are compatible.
